summary: This is the blog index page of Proven Insect Repellent, listing recent posts by author Richard Palmer, mostly from summer and fall 2022. The post excerpts cover what attracts mosquitoes, fall family outdoor activities, tick bites, backpacking essentials, common summer bugs, and keeping bugs away while camping. The page is mainly navigation and site boilerplate around these teaser excerpts.
one_line: Blog index of Proven Insect Repellent listing 2022 posts on mosquitoes, ticks, camping, backpacking and family outdoor activities.
key_facts: The Proven Insect Repellent blog index lists posts by author Richard Palmer.
The post 'What are mosquitoes attracted to?' is dated Sep 8, 2022.
The post 'Outdoor Activities for Your Family in the Fall' is dated Sep 5, 2022.
The post 'What Does a Tick Bite Look Like?' is dated Aug 12, 2022.
The tick post says ticks are tiny eight-legged insects related to spiders and that their bites are typically painless but can result in irritation.
The tick post says adult ticks range in size from as small as the head of a pin to as big as a small watermelon seed.
The post 'Essentials to Carry While Backpacking' is dated Aug 10, 2022 and advises taking only enough gear to be comfortable and prepared for emergencies.
The post 'The Bugs of Summer and What to Do About Them' is dated Jul 13, 2022.
The summer bugs post names mosquitoes, ticks, and black flies as the main bad actors among insects.
The post 'How to Keep Bugs Away When Camping' is dated Jul 11, 2022.
The camping post says getting out and exploring nature means dealing with a wide variety of pesky insects.
The fall post notes that cooler temperatures, lower humidity, and changing leaves make fall a good time to spend a day outside with family.
The site's footer states that PROVEN INSECT REPELLENT is located at PO Box 40066, Overland Park, KS 66204.
The site states that PROVEN was rated Best Bug Spray of 2021 by CNN Underscored.
The blog has an 'Older Entries' link to a second page of posts.
